"""Status: experimental
Purpose: Isolate root versus interior PUCT allocation on two giveaways.
Promote when: Selective prior interventions merit a maintained search option.
"""

import dataclasses
import functools
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch

import run_search_target_probes as probes
from skyjo.experiments import search_diagnostics as diagnostics
from skyjo.experiments.learning_loop_diagnostic import BASE
from skyjo.search import mcts
from skyjo.search.configuration import resolve_components
from skyjo.search.strategies import PUCT


class UniformAllocation(PUCT):
    def scores(self, view):
        return super().scores(
            dataclasses.replace(
                view, priors=np.full(len(view.actions), 1 / len(view.actions))
            )
        )


def main():
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    root = Path.cwd()
    checkpoint = json.loads(
        (root / ".runs/value01-faceoffs-20261018/plan.json").read_text()
    )["checkpoints"]["candidate12"]["path"]
    probes.initialize({"candidate12": checkpoint})
    evaluator = probes._evaluators["candidate12"]
    cases = [
        p
        for p, _ in probes.positions(root / "configs/benchmarks/search_positions.json")
        if p.id.startswith("giveaway")
    ]
    uniform = UniformAllocation(c_puct=1, fpu_reduction=0, fpu_mode="parent")
    output = root / ".runs/target-probes-20261019/split-priors.jsonl"
    with output.open("x") as stream:
        for scope in ["root_only", "interior_only", "both"]:
            components = resolve_components(BASE)
            components = dataclasses.replace(
                components,
                root_exploration=uniform
                if scope != "interior_only"
                else components.root_exploration,
                interior_exploration=uniform
                if scope != "root_only"
                else components.interior_exploration,
            )
            adapter = functools.partial(mcts.run_mcts, components=components)
            for p in cases:
                for seed in range(4):
                    result = diagnostics.run_search(
                        p, evaluator, 2048, seed, config=BASE, search=adapter
                    )
                    snapshots = []
                    previous = None
                    for s in result["trace"]:
                        if s["iteration"] < 32:
                            continue
                        snapshots.append(probes.measure_snapshot(s, p, None, previous))
                        previous = s
                    row = {
                        "scope": scope,
                        "case": p.id,
                        "seed": seed,
                        "witnesses": result["witnesses"],
                        "snapshots": snapshots,
                        "note": "Only PUCT scores use overridden uniform priors at selected depths. Stored model/search_prior fields remain original; values, visit targets and noise-free BASE are unchanged.",
                    }
                    stream.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
                    stream.flush()
                print(scope, p.id, "complete", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
interpretation: 334 search trials. Exact references revalidated; heuristic clear/giveaway labels are not optimal-action oracles. Recent-mass numbers are last-half visit distributions, not trained or faceoff-tested target recipes. Four tactical seeds and two exact seeds on selected fixed cases; do not infer population strength. Allocation-only both-uniform intervention matched the normal uniform arm across all eight corresponding trials.
